no_lyrics_detail: Try another player or search again

font_size.label: Font size
font_size.description: Size of the lyric lines, in points.

direction.label: Direction
direction.description: Whether the next lines come from below or from above.

marker.label: Active line marker
marker.description: Draw a marker to the left of the line being sung.

marker_style.label: Marker style
marker_style.description: Shape of the marker: chevron, bullet, bar, note, block or arrow.

karaoke.label: Karaoke
karaoke.description: Fill the active line as it is sung. With word timings it follows the voice; otherwise the whole line lights up.

ghost.label: Ghost lines
ghost.description: Dim the lines that are not being sung.

header.label: Header
header.description: Show the track title and artist above the lyrics.

footer.label: Footer
footer.description: Show the progress bar and the elapsed time.

active_scale.label: Active line scale
active_scale.description: How much bigger the line being sung is.

visible_above.label: Lines above
visible_above.description: Lines shown before the active one.

visible_below.label: Lines below
visible_below.description: Lines shown after the active one.

accent.label: Accent
accent.description: Colour of the line being sung.

custom_color.label: Custom colour
custom_color.description: Accent colour used when the accent is set to custom.

offset_ms.label: Lyrics offset
offset_ms.description: Shift the lyrics in time, in milliseconds. Positive values show them earlier.

instrumental.label: Instrumental placeholder
instrumental.description: Show a placeholder instead of the last line during instrumental breaks.

instrumental_icon.label: Placeholder icon
instrumental_icon.description: Which notes glyph to show: single note, double note, beamed notes or staff.

instrumental_text.label: Placeholder text
instrumental_text.description: Text shown instead of the icon during instrumental breaks. Leave empty to use the icon.

silence_threshold.label: Instrumental threshold
silence_threshold.description: A gap between lines longer than this (in seconds) counts as instrumental.
